document_title: Comprehensive Physical Commissioning Acceptance Matrix V3
epistemic_mandate: NO GATE MAY PASS BASED ON ARCHITECTURAL ASSUMPTIONS OR SYNTHETIC SIMULATION. Every gate requires on-site physical measurement, calibrated instrumentation, physical evidence artifacts, and signed operator certification.

commissioning_gates.requirement: IEEE 1588-2019 Grandmaster clock locked with >= 8 GNSS satellites; camera P99 offset <= 5.0 ms, CAN P99 offset <= 10.0 ms, secondary sensor P99 offset <= 8.0 ms (if deployed); composite multi-modal skew <= 33.33 ms (nominal 18.0 ms, reserve 15.33 ms). No channel may bypass component limits based on composite skew.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Timestamp offset (P99) per modality relative to PTP master, and composite physical strobe-to-accelerometer impact skew.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-modal optical strobe and physical impactor captured simultaneously by cameras and vehicle accelerometer, with PTP 1PPS probe monitoring on DSO.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope + Vector VN1640A Interface + Co-Calibration Impactor Strobe Rig
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: actual_composite_skew <= 33.33 ms AND camera_p99 <= 5.0 ms AND can_p99 <= 10.0 ms AND secondary_p99 <= 8.0 ms (if deployed)
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: SYNC_NOMINAL_PASS: composite_skew <= 33.33 ms AND camera_p99 <= 2.0 ms AND can_p99 <= 5.0 ms AND secondary_p99 <= 5.0 ms.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: SYNC_RESERVE_CONSUMED / PASS_WITH_DEGRADED_MARGIN: composite_skew <= 33.33 ms AND (camera_p99 in (2.0, 5.0] ms OR can_p99 in (5.0, 10.0] ms OR secondary_p99 in (5.0, 8.0] ms). Triggers automated jitter warning log and requires engineering review.
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: SYNC_FAIL: composite_skew > 33.33 ms OR camera_p99 > 5.0 ms OR can_p99 > 10.0 ms OR secondary_p99 > 8.0 ms. Triggers immediate DATA_INVALIDATION_ABORT.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All deployed cameras (A, C mandatory; B, D if deployed) rigidly mounted with 9.5 N*m bolt torque; lens focus and aperture mechanically locked with set-screws; zero dropped frames over 30-min continuous ingest.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Fastener torque (N*m), focus lock state, and frame drop counter across all deployed optical streams.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Calibrated torque wrench physical audit of mounting bolts and lens barrels; Wireshark automated frame drop monitor on RTSP/GigE streams.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Norbar Calibrated Torque Wrench (1.0-20.0 N*m, ISO 6789) + Wireshark Network Packet Monitor
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: frame_drop_count == 0 over 30 min across all deployed cameras AND all mount bolt torques == 9.5 N*m
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: CAMERA_RIGIDITY_VERIFIED: Zero dropped frames over 30 min AND all mounting bolts torqued to 9.5 N*m.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Zero frame drop tolerance; strict binary gate).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: CAMERA_FAILURE: Any dropped frame detected OR any fastener torque < 9.5 N*m.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All MANDATORY_RAW_SIGNALS active, monotonic timestamps, continuous streaming (zero packet gaps > 20ms), SI units confirmed, steering_rate derivation verified via 2nd-order Butterworth filter, brake_pressure_bar marked UNAVAILABLE.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: CAN frame arrival interval (ms), bit error counter, timestamp monotonicity, and signal unit scaling.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus tap monitoring 50 Hz frames during low-speed shakedown roll.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Vector CANoe with VN1640A non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus interface
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: can_packet_gap_max_ms <= 20.0 ms AND zero corrupt frames AND all mandatory signals streaming with monotonic timestamps
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: CAN_TELEMETRY_PASS: Packet gaps <= 20.0 ms, zero corrupt frames, and SI units validated.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Telemetry drop violates candidate generation pre-conditions).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: CAN_TELEMETRY_FAIL: Any packet gap > 20.0 ms, frame corruption, or missing mandatory signal.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Secondary Hazard Zone Bounded Sampled Observability Proof
commissioning_gates.requirement: Bounded 3D spatial grid sweep across secondary cross-aisle corridor (36 discrete sample points, 0m to 20m depth, 2.4m grid span across 3.5m corridor width, 0.8-1.8m height); Camera C achieves >= 65.0 px/m resolution at 20m depth; zero point occlusions across all 36 test points. Continuous volumetric zero-blindness unproven, marked UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Pixel density (px/m) on standardized target (SPMT-01) at 36 discrete sample coordinates, and direct line-of-sight visibility.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Physical target sweep with SPMT-01 mannequin across 36 discrete measurement grid points; automated OpenCV pixel resolution audit and surveyor laser depth measurement.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Measure + OpenCV target resolution validator + SPMT-01 Target
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: sample_points_passed == 36 AND pixel_density_at_20m >= 65.0 px/m AND surveyed_permanent_obstructions == 0
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: SAMPLED_OBSERVABILITY_PASS: All 36 points pass resolution and visibility. Continuous area coverage explicitly classified as UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (All 36 points must satisfy minimum resolution).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: OBSERVABILITY_FAIL: Any sample point occluded OR resolution < 65.0 px/m at 20m depth.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Intrinsic & Extrinsic Geometric Calibration (All Deployed Cameras)
commissioning_gates.requirement: Photogrammetric calibration across all deployed cameras (A, C mandatory; B, D if deployed); RMS reprojection error <= 1.50 px using 12x9 ChArUco diamond board. Undeployed cameras marked NOT_DEPLOYED / NOT_APPLICABLE and do not produce a gate failure.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Reprojection error RMS (pixels) across calibration target corners and extrinsic transformation rigid-body matrices.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-pose ChArUco diamond board physical acquisition (50+ diverse board angles per camera); OpenCV pinhole camera model bundle adjustment.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Calib.io Certified Precision Aluminum ChArUco Calibration Target (12x9 grid)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: rms_reprojection_error_px <= 1.50 px across all deployed cameras (undeployed cameras marked NOT_APPLICABLE)
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: CALIBRATION_PASS: RMS reprojection error <= 1.50 px across all deployed cameras.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: CALIBRATION_MARGIN_CONSUMED: 1.20 px < RMS <= 1.50 px (Acceptable, but triggers calibration quality notice).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: CALIBRATION_FAIL: RMS reprojection error > 1.50 px on any deployed camera.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Total Station survey defining facility brass origin monument, floor ground plane equation Ax+By+Cz+D=0 (residual RMS <= 3.0 mm), travel corridor boundaries, and exclusion zone perimeter.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: 3D geodetic monument coordinates (X, Y, Z mm) and ground plane fitting residual RMS (mm).
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Licensed geodetic survey using reflectorless optical total station referencing permanent building structural columns.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica TS16 Total Station (1" angle accuracy, 1mm + 1.5ppm EDM)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: ground_plane_rms_residual_mm <= 3.0 mm AND facility monument coordinates locked in local Cartesian CRS
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: GEOMETRY_PASS: Ground plane RMS residual <= 3.0 mm and facility monument fixed.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Ground plane residual > 3.0 mm invalidates ground plane projection).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: GEOMETRY_FAIL: Ground plane RMS residual > 3.0 mm or monument coordinate drift.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Physical Corridor Illuminance & High-Frequency Flicker Commissioning
commissioning_gates.requirement: Path 1: Physical lux meter measurement confirming mean illuminance within 350 +/- 50 lux across 5 corridor points. Path 2: Dedicated high-frequency optical photodetector (>= 1.0 MSa/s, 50 kHz bandwidth, 4th-order anti-alias filter) confirming flicker index <= 0.05 and driver frequency >= 1000 Hz. Separates illuminance from temporal light modulation.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Photopic illuminance E_v (lux), Flicker Index (FI), and fundamental modulation frequency f_mod (Hz).
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Dual-path audit: Class B photometer grid sweep across corridor (Path 1) + high-speed photodiode oscilloscope capture under luminaire optical axis (Path 2).
commissioning_gates.instrument: Path 1: Testo 540 / Gossen Mavolux 5032B Lux Meter. Path 2: Thorlabs PDA36A2 Photodetector + Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope.
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: 300.0 lux <= mean_lux <= 400.0 lux AND flicker_index <= 0.05 AND modulation_frequency >= 1000.0 Hz
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: ILLUMINANCE_AND_FLICKER_PASS: Both Path 1 and Path 2 meet acceptance targets.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: ILLUMINANCE_DEGRADED: 280 lux <= mean_lux < 300 lux OR 400 lux < mean_lux <= 420 lux with flicker_index <= 0.05 (Acceptable with camera gain compensation).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: ILLUMINANCE_FLICKER_FAIL: Mean lux outside [280, 420] lux OR flicker_index > 0.05 OR modulation_frequency < 1000 Hz.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: E-Stop Safety Circuit & Traction Cutoff Latency Acceptance
commissioning_gates.requirement: Dedicated wireless remote E-Stop with vendor Notified Body component certificate (Cat 4 / PLe / SIL-3); oscilloscope trace proves traction motor current cutoff (t_traction_safe_state - t_estop_command <= 50.0 ms where I_motor < 0.5 A RMS) and contactor auxiliary microswitch opening <= 35.0 ms. Motor current cutoff is separated from DC bus capacitor discharge and mechanical brake engagement.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Electrical transition latencies (ms) from E-Stop switch NC contact opening to safety output drop, contactor auxiliary opening, and motor phase current extinction.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: 4-channel isolated digital storage oscilloscope measuring E-Stop NC switch break vs contactor auxiliary contact and Hall-effect motor current clamp.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G 4-Channel Oscilloscope + Tektronix TCP303 / A622 Current Clamp
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: delta_t_traction <= 50.0 ms (I_motor < 0.5 A) AND delta_t_contactor <= 35.0 ms AND vendor component certificate on file
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: E_STOP_PASS: delta_t_traction <= 50.0 ms, contactor opening <= 35.0 ms, and component certificates verified.
commissioning_gates.DEGRADED_RESERVE_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Strict safety cutoff threshold; any latency > 50.0 ms is an immediate failure).
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: E_STOP_FAIL: delta_t_traction > 50.0 ms OR contactor opening > 35.0 ms OR missing vendor component certificate.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Physical microphone disconnection/desoldering on all cameras; formal bilateral Data Agreement executed between Research Consortium, Facility Operating Company, and Labor Safety Representatives.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Physical audio hardware disablement confirmation and cryptographic signature status of bilateral legal agreements.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Physical hardware visual inspection of camera PCB audio traces + cryptographic signature verification on legal agreement.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Visual hardware inspection + cryptographic document ledger
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: microphone_physically_disconnected == TRUE across all cameras AND formal_site_agreement_signed == TRUE
commissioning_gates.PASS_state: PRIVACY_CLEARANCE_PASS: Hardware audio disabled and formal agreements executed.
commissioning_gates.FAIL_state: PRIVACY_CLEARANCE_FAIL: Any microphone hardware intact OR missing stakeholder agreement.
commissioning_gates.responsible_authority: Site Legal Counsel & Lead Principal Investigator
